title: Plan employee training and development
summary: When a role, promotion, control or business change creates a capability or training need. A role-based development plan with completed learning evidence and an assessment of practical capability.
outcomes: A role-based development plan with completed learning evidence and an assessment of practical capability.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a role, promotion, control or business change creates a capability or training need.

parts.title: Identify role and control-specific skill gaps
parts.guidance: Compare expected work with observed performance, new tools, customer commitments and required training. Separate mandatory certifications from optional development and record who needs each capability.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Agree learning objectives and support
parts.guidance: The employee and manager choose observable outcomes, learning time, mentoring and budget. Confirm any external qualification or training requirement with the relevant owner instead of assuming course attendance establishes competence.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Schedule learning and supervised practice
parts.guidance: Prepare a plan combining instruction, practice tasks, accessible materials and feedback. Assign the reviewer and keep production or customer work within the employee's current authorization.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Assess application of the new skill
parts.guidance: The employee performs an agreed practical task or assessment with appropriate supervision. Record the evidence and any gaps; completion of an automated quiz alone need not establish readiness for high-risk work.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Assess application of the new skill

parts.title: Update the capability plan and review date
parts.guidance: Retain approved completion evidence, record role changes requiring access or authority review and agree the next development priorities. Revisit the plan when the job or control requirements change.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: A role-based development plan with completed learning evidence and an assessment of practical capability.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting.
